entities.summary: Malcolm-Jamaal Justin Subban is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who plays goaltender for HC Dynamo Pardubice of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). Subban was selected by the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the first round, 24th overall, of the 2012 NHL entry draft. He also previously played for the Vegas Golden Knights, Chicago Blackhawks, Buffalo Sabres, and Columbus Blue Jackets. He played junior hockey in the Ontario Hockey League with the Belleville Bulls.
